# Barbara Shaw

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 XII A Jonah Day P2](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0002)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) (relative)

## Appearance

Barbara Shaw is a tall and awkward girl. She often appears as though she has too many hands and feet.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P6](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0006)_

## Personality

Barbara Shaw is characterized by her clumsiness, to the extent that walking down the aisle without tripping is a noteworthy event for the local scholars. Despite this, she possesses an eager desire to be useful, though her well-meaning actions can sometimes lead to hasty mistakes.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P6](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0006), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P20](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0020)_

## Traits

- clumsy  <sub>[v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P6](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0006)</sub>

## Abilities

_Not yet known._

## Goals

- desire to be useful  <sub>[v2 XII A Jonah Day P20](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0020)</sub>

## History

Barbara Shaw moved to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) to live with her aunt, having previously visited her [Aunt Mary](../character/mary-joe.md) the prior winter. She eventually attended the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school under the instruction of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md).

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P0](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0000), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P6](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0006), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P13](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0013), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P21](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0021), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P33](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0033)_
